meaning: the entity is a fence: a run from its pose along its heading that no robot crosses

schema.title: fence
schema.description: the entity is a fence: a run from its pose along its heading that no robot crosses
schema.$comment: Written for world-proto's registry from dessim's `FenceComponent` (libs/dessim/src/worldmap/safeguards.rs on wip/cencora-fences-curtains at 063d32210). dessim's loader drops every link the run meets and refuses a link lying along it. Open to fields a newer writer adds, as the vocabulary's other definitions are; dessim's reader refuses a field it does not know.

length.description: How far the run reaches from the pose along its heading, in steps of the pose's frame.

height.description: How tall it stands in the drawing, in steps of the primary frame.
